# NEW 2026-11-20 v6.7 L5 first part, the plague and Thrace (phases 1-3). Generated by gen_l5_plague.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope, monthly. Called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES, id 28); this line writes no
# monthly hook of its own. Order (design 3.3): start, close (1453.6.1, or from 1372.1.1 when the City is lost); the world
# step W1; then at most one event.
oe_l5_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_l5_off } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_l5_live } } set_global_variable = oe_l5_live }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_l5_on } } set_variable = oe_l5_on }
        set_variable = { name = oe_l5_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { current_date >= 1453.6.1 AND = { current_date >= 1372.1.1 NOT = { location:constantinople = { owner ?= c:BYZ } } } } }
            set_variable = oe_l5_off
            debug_log = "oe_l5: the line is closed (st [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l5_rd_st')|0])"
        }
        else = {
            oe_l5_world = yes
            oe_l5_events = yes
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. Events (design 3.3): lapse, then at most one. .1 waits only for the lock; .6 and .3 also for calm;
# .6 does not wait for the lock from month 408 (1370.12, decision 243 item 11).
oe_l5_events = {
    if = { limit = { oe_l5_gone_1 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_st_1 value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_l5_late_1 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_st_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_l5_gone_6 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_st_6 value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_l5_late_6 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_st_6 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_l5_gone_5 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_st_5 value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_l5_late_5 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_st_5 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_l5_gone_7 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_st_7 value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_l5_late_7 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_st_7 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_l5_late_3 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_st_3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_l5_gone_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_st_2 value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_l5_late_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_st_2 value = 2 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_l5_pick value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_l5_pick = 0 oe_ml_free = yes oe_l5_ok_1 = yes } random = { chance = oe_l5_ch_1 set_variable = { name = oe_l5_pick value = 1 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_l5_pick = 0 OR = { oe_ml_free = yes var:oe_l5_m >= 408 } oe_l5_calm = yes oe_l5_ok_6 = yes } random = { chance = oe_l5_ch_6 set_variable = { name = oe_l5_pick value = 6 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_l5_pick = 0 oe_ml_free = yes oe_l5_calm = yes oe_l5_ok_5 = yes } random = { chance = oe_l5_ch_5 set_variable = { name = oe_l5_pick value = 5 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_l5_pick = 0 OR = { oe_ml_free = yes var:oe_l5_m >= 417 } oe_l5_calm = yes oe_l5_ok_7 = yes } random = { chance = oe_l5_ch_7 set_variable = { name = oe_l5_pick value = 7 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_l5_pick = 0 oe_ml_free = yes oe_l5_calm = yes oe_l5_ok_3 = yes } random = { chance = oe_l5_ch_3 set_variable = { name = oe_l5_pick value = 3 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_l5_pick = 0 oe_ml_free = yes oe_l5_calm = yes oe_l5_ok_2 = yes } random = { chance = oe_l5_ch_2 set_variable = { name = oe_l5_pick value = 2 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_l5_pick = 0 oe_ml_free = yes oe_l5_calm = yes oe_l5_ok_8 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_pick value = 8 } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_l5_pick = 1 } oe_l5_send_1 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_l5_pick = 6 } oe_l5_send_6 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_l5_pick = 5 } oe_l5_send_5 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_l5_pick = 7 } oe_l5_send_7 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_l5_pick = 3 } oe_l5_send_3 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_l5_pick = 2 } oe_l5_send_2 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_l5_pick = 8 } oe_l5_send_8 = yes }
    remove_variable = oe_l5_pick
}

# BYZ scope. The sender of each event: its state (st 1) and the event. The monthly check and the test buttons both use
# it, so a button shows the event exactly as the month would (r21: a value the sender stores is missing when an event is
# fired from the console; the chances in the texts are script values read when the text is shown).
oe_l5_send_1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_l5_st_1 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_last value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_wait_2 months = 18 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_l5.1 }
oe_l5_send_6 = { set_variable = { name = oe_l5_st_6 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_last value = 6 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_l5.6 }
oe_l5_send_5 = { set_variable = { name = oe_l5_st_5 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_last value = 5 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_l5.5 }
oe_l5_send_7 = { set_variable = { name = oe_l5_st_7 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_last value = 7 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_l5.7 }
oe_l5_send_3 = { set_variable = { name = oe_l5_st_3 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_last value = 3 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_l5.3 }
oe_l5_send_2 = { set_variable = { name = oe_l5_st_2 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_last value = 2 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_l5.2 }
oe_l5_send_8 = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l5_ret_n } change_variable = { name = oe_l5_ret_n add = 1 } } else = { set_variable = { name = oe_l5_ret_n value = 1 } } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_ret_cd years = 10 } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_st_8 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_last value = 8 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_l5.8 }

# BYZ scope. Pay $months$ months of income (oe_fin_month); manpower: the new-cost rule of brief B6 (only while it grows).
oe_l5_pay = { add_gold = { value = oe_fin_month multiply = -$months$ } }
oe_l5_men = { if = { limit = { monthly_manpower > 0 } add_manpower = { value = monthly_manpower multiply = -$months$ } } }
# BYZ scope. Gain $months$ months of income (phase 2: .2 b, .5 b).
oe_l5_gain = { add_gold = { value = oe_fin_month multiply = $months$ } }

# BYZ scope. Fires the hidden worker oe_l5.90 with job $j$ (option effects stay out of the option previews).
oe_l5_run_job = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l5_job value = $j$ }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_l5.90
}

# ---- the three engine forms not yet seen in this direction (brief): each in ONE effect, behind a generator switch.
# BYZ scope. Hand Adrianoúpolis to the AI Ottomans (switch HANDOVER = change_location_owner): only while oe_l5_may_cede_edirne
# holds (ours, under our control, nobody's capital, no siege; the Ottomans AI). Self-check afterwards: oe_l5_ceded 1 when
# the Ottomans own it, else 0 and the failure code oe_l5_fail = 6 (nothing depends on it).
oe_l5_cede_edirne = {
    if = { limit = { oe_l5_may_cede_edirne = yes } location:edirne = { change_location_owner = c:TUR } }
    if = { limit = { location:edirne = { owner ?= c:TUR } } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_ceded value = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_l5_ceded value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_fail value = 6 } }
}
# BYZ scope. A truce of $years$ years with the Ottomans after a handover (switch TRUCE = True; not seen in game).
oe_l5_truce_tur = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR } add_truce_with = { target = c:TUR years = $years$ mutual = yes } }
}
# BYZ scope. .6 c: the Orthodox of Adrianoúpolis move to the capital (switch MIGRATE = cross). "cross": after the
# handover, vanilla's invite_settlers form (owner = the new owner, to_owner = the empire); "internal": before it, the
# empire's own migration. Only when the capital is ours.
oe_l5_move_greeks_edirne = {
    if = { limit = { location:constantinople = { owner ?= c:BYZ } location:edirne = { owner ?= c:TUR } } add_migration = { owner = c:TUR to_owner = c:BYZ from_location = location:edirne to_location = location:constantinople religion = religion:orthodox amount = 1 months = 12 } }
}
# Any scope. The result of .6, kept on the empire and as a global for the vassal line and the chronicle (design 3.10).
oe_l5_set_adr = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l5_adr value = $v$ }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_l5_adr value = $v$ }
}
# ---- phase 2: the same three forms for Didymóteichon (.5), each in ONE effect behind the same switches.
# BYZ scope. Hand Didymóteichon to the AI Ottomans: only while oe_l5_may_cede_demotica holds. Self-check: oe_l5_ceded
# 1 when the Ottomans own it, else 0 and the failure code oe_l5_fail = 5 (nothing depends on it).
oe_l5_cede_demotica = {
    if = { limit = { oe_l5_may_cede_demotica = yes } location:demotica = { change_location_owner = c:TUR } }
    if = { limit = { location:demotica = { owner ?= c:TUR } } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_ceded value = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_l5_ceded value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_fail value = 5 } }
}
# BYZ scope. .5 c: the Orthodox of Didymóteichon move to the capital (switch MIGRATE = cross; as .6 c).
oe_l5_move_greeks_demotica = {
    if = { limit = { location:constantinople = { owner ?= c:BYZ } location:demotica = { owner ?= c:TUR } } add_migration = { owner = c:TUR to_owner = c:BYZ from_location = location:demotica to_location = location:constantinople religion = religion:orthodox amount = 0.5 months = 12 } }
}
# Any scope. The result of .5, on the empire and as a global (design 3.10).
oe_l5_set_dem = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l5_demotica value = $v$ }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_l5_demotica value = $v$ }
}

# ---- phase 2: world step W1, Philippópolis (design 3.5). BYZ scope, monthly, before the events; no pop-up, no lock.
# Global oe_l5_ws_1: 1 done, 2 the window passed, 3 skipped (the empire's bloc or a player holds it), 4 already Ottoman,
# 5 the handover did not go through (self-check; nothing depends on it). Never a player's location (decision 243 item 2).
oe_l5_world = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_l5_ws_1 } has_variable = oe_l5_m var:oe_l5_m >= 306 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_l5_m > 348 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_l5_ws_1 value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_l5_w1_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_l5_ws_1 value = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_l5_w1_tur = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_l5_ws_1 value = 4 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_l5_w1_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_l5_ch_w1 oe_l5_w1 = yes } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. W1 itself (also the test button l5w1): hand Philippópolis to the Ottomans while oe_l5_w1_ok holds; self-check.
oe_l5_w1 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_l5_w1_ok = yes }
        location:plovdiv = { change_location_owner = c:TUR }
        if = {
            limit = { location:plovdiv = { owner ?= c:TUR } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_l5_ws_1 value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_l5_philippopolis value = 1 }
        }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_l5_ws_1 value = 5 } }
    }
}

# ---- the worker's jobs (oe_l5.90)
# 1: Andronikos Kantakouzenos dies of the plague (.1; still alive, in the empire, neither ruler nor heir).
oe_l5_job_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = character:byz_andronikos_kantakouzenos }
	    if = { limit = { oe_l5_andr_dies = yes } character:byz_andronikos_kantakouzenos = { kill_character_silently = this } }
	}
}
# 61: .6 a, defend the city: the roll (oe_l5_hold_chance_adr; the test buttons l5roll0 / l5roll1 fix it once through
# oe_l5_roll_force: 1 fails, 2 holds). Held: oe_l5_held for 20 years. Lost: the handover, a truce of 5
# years, stability. The result notice oe_l5.91 reads oe_l5_res (611 held, 612 lost and handed over, 613 lost but the
# handover did not go through).
oe_l5_job_61 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l5_roll value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_l5_roll_force ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_roll value = 1 } }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_l5_roll_force } }
        random = { chance = oe_l5_hold_chance_adr set_variable = { name = oe_l5_roll value = 1 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l5_roll_force } remove_variable = oe_l5_roll_force }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_l5_roll = 1 }
        location:edirne = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_l5_held years = 20 mode = replace } }
        oe_l5_set_adr = { v = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_l5_res value = 611 }
    }
    else = {
        oe_l5_cede_edirne = yes
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_l5_ceded ?= 1 }
            oe_l5_truce_tur = { years = 5 }
            add_stability = stability_mild_penalty
            set_variable = { name = oe_l5_res value = 612 }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_l5_res value = 613 } }
        oe_l5_set_adr = { v = 2 }
    }
    remove_variable = oe_l5_roll
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l5_ceded } remove_variable = oe_l5_ceded }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_l5.91
}
# 62: .6 b, open the gates (history): the handover, a truce of 10 years, the Ottomans think well of us.
oe_l5_job_62 = {
    oe_l5_cede_edirne = yes
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_l5_ceded ?= 1 }
        oe_l5_truce_tur = { years = 10 }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR } c:TUR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_l5_b_gift target = c:BYZ } } }
    }
    oe_l5_set_adr = { v = 3 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l5_ceded } remove_variable = oe_l5_ceded }
}
# 63: .6 c, take the Greeks away: the handover, the migration, a truce of 5 years, the metropolitan comes home.
oe_l5_job_63 = {
    # MIGRATE: the move follows the handover
    oe_l5_cede_edirne = yes
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_l5_ceded ?= 1 }
        oe_l5_move_greeks_edirne = yes
        oe_l5_truce_tur = { years = 5 }
        oe_ecc_pres_add = { amount = 1 }
    }
    oe_l5_set_adr = { v = 4 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l5_ceded } remove_variable = oe_l5_ceded }
}
# 51: .5 a (phase 2), hold Didymóteichon: the roll (oe_l5_hold_chance; l5roll0 / l5roll1 fix it once, as for .6 a).
# Held: oe_l5_held for 20 years, +15 on the roll of .6 a. Lost: the handover, a truce of 5 years,
# prestige. The notice oe_l5.91 reads oe_l5_res (511 held, 512 lost and handed over, 513 lost but not handed over).
oe_l5_job_51 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l5_roll value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_l5_roll_force ?= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_l5_roll value = 1 } }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_l5_roll_force } }
        random = { chance = oe_l5_hold_chance set_variable = { name = oe_l5_roll value = 1 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l5_roll_force } remove_variable = oe_l5_roll_force }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_l5_roll = 1 }
        location:demotica = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_l5_held years = 20 mode = replace } }
        oe_l5_set_dem = { v = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_l5_res value = 511 }
    }
    else = {
        oe_l5_cede_demotica = yes
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_l5_ceded ?= 1 }
            oe_l5_truce_tur = { years = 5 }
            add_prestige = prestige_mild_penalty
            set_variable = { name = oe_l5_res value = 512 }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_l5_res value = 513 } }
        oe_l5_set_dem = { v = 2 }
    }
    remove_variable = oe_l5_roll
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l5_ceded } remove_variable = oe_l5_ceded }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_l5.91
}
# 52: .5 b, give the town up (history): the handover, a truce of 10 years, the Ottomans think well of us and pay
# a ransom of 1 month(s) of income -- all only when the handover went through.
oe_l5_job_52 = {
    oe_l5_cede_demotica = yes
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_l5_ceded ?= 1 }
        oe_l5_truce_tur = { years = 10 }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR } c:TUR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_l5_b_gift target = c:BYZ } } }
        oe_l5_gain = { months = 1 }
    }
    oe_l5_set_dem = { v = 3 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l5_ceded } remove_variable = oe_l5_ceded }
}
# 53: .5 c, bring the people away: the handover, the migration, a truce of 5 years.
oe_l5_job_53 = {
    # MIGRATE: the move follows the handover
    oe_l5_cede_demotica = yes
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_l5_ceded ?= 1 }
        oe_l5_move_greeks_demotica = yes
        oe_l5_truce_tur = { years = 5 }
    }
    oe_l5_set_dem = { v = 4 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l5_ceded } remove_variable = oe_l5_ceded }
}

oe_l5_log = { debug_log = "oe_l5 m=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l5_rd_m')|0] st=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l5_rd_st')|0] plague=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l5_rd_plague')|0] flags=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l5_rd_flags')|0] andr=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l5_rd_andr')|0] way=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l5_rd_way')|0] buda=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l5_rd_buda')|0] adr=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l5_rd_adr')|0] fail=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l5_rd_fail')|0] hold%=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l5_hold_chance_adr')|0] force=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l5_rd_force')|0] last=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l5_rd_last')|0] st2=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l5_rd_st2')|0] flags2=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l5_rd_flags2')|0] empty=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l5_rd_empty')|0] dem=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l5_rd_dem')|0] ugl=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l5_rd_ugl')|0] ret=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l5_rd_ret')|0] retway=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l5_rd_retway')|0] hold5%=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_l5_hold_chance')|0] owners edirne=[GetLocationByKey('edirne').GetOwner.GetName] demotica=[GetLocationByKey('demotica').GetOwner.GetName] plovdiv=[GetLocationByKey('plovdiv').GetOwner.GetName]" }

# ---- test buttons only (DEV_LINES)
# BYZ scope. Show an event now through its sender: the date, the chance, the lock, the plague (.1), calm and the
# Ottoman strength are left out; the event's own trigger (the world fact its text tells) is still checked.
oe_l5_test_1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l5_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_l5_ev_1 = yes } oe_l5_send_1 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_l5 test: .1 cannot be shown (the City is not ours)" }
}
oe_l5_test_3 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l5_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_l5_ev_3 = yes } oe_l5_send_3 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_l5 test: .3 cannot be shown (Hungary gone, not AI, not Catholic, at war with us or our subject; or the empire is not Orthodox, is a subject, or has no adult ruler)" }
}
oe_l5_test_6 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l5_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_l5_ev_6 = yes } oe_l5_send_6 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_l5 test: .6 cannot be shown (Adrianoúpolis not ours, not under our control, besieged or a capital; or the Ottomans gone or a player)" }
}

    else = { debug_log = "oe_l5 test: .5 cannot be shown (Didymóteichon not ours, not under our control, besieged or a capital; or the Ottomans gone or a player)" }
}
oe_l5_test_7 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l5_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_l5_ev_7 = yes } oe_l5_send_7 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_l5 test: .7 cannot be shown (Serbia gone or a player, or Serres not Serbian)" }
}
oe_l5_test_8 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l5_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_l5_ev_8 = yes } oe_l5_send_8 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_l5 test: .8 cannot be shown (the City is not ours)" }
}
# BYZ scope. Run the world step W1 now, the window and the chance aside. Its full condition (oe_l5_w1_ok) is still
# checked, so in a 1337 game (plovdiv is the empire's) nothing changes and the log says why.
oe_l5_test_w1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_l5_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = { limit = { oe_l5_w1_ok = yes } oe_l5_w1 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_l5 test: W1 cannot run (Philippópolis is the empire's side's, a player's or the Ottomans', besieged, a capital; or the Ottomans hold fewer than 2 places of Thrace or are a player)" }
}
# BYZ scope. Fix the next roll of .6 a: $r$ = 1 fails, 2 holds.
oe_l5_test_roll = { set_variable = { name = oe_l5_roll_force value = $r$ } }
# BYZ scope. Switch "the Ottomans count as stronger" (oe_l5_ott_strong) on, or off again.
oe_l5_test_strong = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l5_strong_test } remove_variable = oe_l5_strong_test }
    else = { set_variable = oe_l5_strong_test }
}
# Any scope. Seed the plague in the City: vanilla's own form (flavor_gen.44) while the plague is active in the world,
# else spawn_disease. Tests both forms of oe_l5_plague_in_city (read them with l5log).
oe_l5_test_seed = {
    if = {
        limit = { disease_is_active = disease:bubonic_plague }
        location:constantinople = { set_disease_presence = { disease_outbreak = disease:bubonic_plague.original_outbreak value = 1 } }
    }
    else = { location:constantinople = { spawn_disease = { disease = disease:bubonic_plague value = 1 } } }
}
# BYZ scope. Forget this line's state and its modifiers (what the events changed in the world stays: a city handed over
# stays handed over, a dead man stays dead).
oe_l5_test_reset = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l5_on } remove_variable = oe_l5_on }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l5_off } remove_variable = oe_l5_off }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l5_m } remove_variable = oe_l5_m }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l5_last } remove_variable = oe_l5_last }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l5_pick } remove_variable = oe_l5_pick }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l5_andr } remove_variable = oe_l5_andr }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l5_plague_way } remove_variable = oe_l5_plague_way }

    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_l5_stranded } remove_variable = oe_l5_stranded }
